subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core or plugin contract plus security and fallback policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, retention, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Define First-Class Chat Video Input
options.body: Approve a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-provider contract with security limits, fallback behavior, and tests before landing or replacing an implementation.

options.title: Keep Video In Media Understanding
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the existing infer video/media-understanding path as the supported workflow for now.

options.title: Prove Provider-Specific Paths First
options.body: Let provider-specific implementations such as MiniMax M3 prove native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Define First-Class Chat Video Input
recommendation.body: Approve a coherent WebChat/Gateway/model-provider contract with security limits, fallback behavior, and tests before landing or replacing an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review context and nearby media/provider architecture history make steipete the best available owner for the cross-cutting product/security choice.
